title: Setting up the recording and giving the tempo
summary: Check that the recorder is picking up voices, then the students ask for the faster numbers and a tempo is tapped off. Much of the text is ASR repetition.

blocks.x: I like that. Let's go back into the other one for the same thing. Did you pick that up?
Yeah, we got it fixed up. It's recording, I think. It'll pick up your voice. Don't worry about it. You'll have to pay attention.

If you have any luck, we'll get it. With the faster numbers, you do the same beat there? Oh yeah, the faster, same thing. It's exactly the same roll there. Same roll, yeah. Tap off on a tempo. You tap off on a tempo, and I'll see if you can pick it up there.
I tried to play one beat. I tried to play one beat, with that same tempo. I'm just giving you the tempo in four and four. Then I went up.
